units.title: Unit 1: Personal Life, Upbringing & Past Events

lessons.title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
grammar: Past Simple for completed past actions and main storyline events
Past Continuous for background actions in progress (was/were + -ing)
Interrupted actions using when and while
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-A2-001"
pronunciation: [{"point":"Past simple -ed endings","explain":"Distinguish between /t/, /d/, and /ɪd/ endings for regular past tense verbs.","examples":[{"pattern":"worked / played / started","ipa":"/wɜːkt/ / /pleɪd/ / /ˈstɑː.tɪd/","word":"started"}],"visual":"🗣️"}]
cando: "Can narrate a simple past event and describe background actions using when and while"

lessons.title: Past Habits & Life Experiences (Used to & Present Perfect)
grammar: Used to + infinitive for past habits and states no longer true
Present Perfect with ever and never for life experiences
Contrast between Past Simple (finished time) and Present Perfect (unfinished time)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-A2-002"
pronunciation: [{"point":"The used to liaison","explain":"The final d in used and initial t in to blend into a single /tuː/ sound.","examples":[{"pattern":"used to","ipa":"/ˈjuːs.tə/","word":"used to"}],"visual":"🔗"}]
cando: "Can describe past habits and talk about general life experiences"

units.title: Unit 2: Expressing Future Plans, Intentions & Arrangements

lessons.title: Future Tenses Contrast (Will vs Be Going To vs Present Continuous)
grammar: Be going to + infinitive for intentions and prior plans
Present Continuous for fixed arrangements with a specific time or place
Will + infinitive for spontaneous decisions, promises, and predictions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-A2-003"
pronunciation: [{"point":"Weak form of going to (gonna)","explain":"In casual speech, going to often reduces to /ˈɡən.ə/.","examples":[{"pattern":"going to","ipa":"/ˈɡən.ə/","word":"gonna"}],"visual":"🗣️"}]
cando: "Can talk about future plans, arrangements, and spontaneous decisions"
